title.zh: Indonesia's Largest Crypto Exchange Indodax Suspends Deposits and Withdrawals Am
title.en: Indonesia's Largest Crypto Exchange Indodax Suspends Deposits and Withdrawals Am

current_state.zh: Indonesia's largest crypto exchange Indodax temporarily suspended deposits and withdrawals after detecting a spike in cyberattack attempts, saying customer assets are secure and no unauthorized withdrawals or data breaches were found while security assessments proceed.
